name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-chrome-mcp
description: Local (unpublished) web_search provider for the DeepSeek Harness ctx.web seam: drives a real Chrome browser (raw CDP) through a stdio MCP server at ~/.dsh/chrome-mcp. OFF by default - opt in with DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=chrome-mcp or by editing the 'web' row's searchProvider in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml.
